title: Inviting friends
summary: Send the invite and get everyone into your world.

sections.heading: Send the invite
steps: Start the server and wait until it says Server online.
Press Copy invite on the Dashboard and paste it in Discord.
The password is never in the invite. Tell your friends yourself if you set one.

sections.heading: What your friends need
steps: Bannerlord, the Coop mod and Coodsz Coop Client Launcher.
The same mods and the same map as your server.
Then they join from Steam lobby, or with your address and the UDP port.

sections.heading: If they cannot connect
steps: Tick Open the port on my router automatically on the Dashboard.
Press Allow through firewall. Windows asks you first.
Still nothing? Forward UDP port 4200 on your router by hand, or use Steam lobby.
A home network address only works for people on your own WiFi.
sections.tip: Press How will friends join? to see which way works for your setup.
